reviews.label: C01
reviews.strength: The table, doors and installation angles address different, recognisable concerns.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace repeated childproofing-plan language with a more direct benefit in each ad.

reviews.label: C02
reviews.strength: Specific components and installation support provide reassurance without overpromising.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the outlet and furniture copy less about making a plan and more about what each included part addresses.

reviews.label: C03
reviews.strength: Clearly combines the kit, listed price, support and purchase terms.
reviews.priority_fix: Give one variant a specific household moment instead of repeating the full contents list.

reviews.label: C04
reviews.strength: The first ad makes the appeal of considering one kit instead of separate products clear.
reviews.priority_fix: Shorten the repeated inventory lists in the support and prepaid variants.

reviews.label: C05
reviews.strength: Installation uncertainty is addressed directly with the supported video-help offer.
reviews.priority_fix: Give the three variants different executions; each currently pairs nearly the same list with the same support message.

reviews.label: C06
reviews.strength: Picturable table and cabinet concerns make the first two ads relevant; the third handles setup hesitation.
reviews.priority_fix: Trim phrases that restate the childproofing-routine point without adding information.

reviews.label: C07
reviews.strength: Addresses the separate-products comparison and states the price and support plainly.
reviews.priority_fix: Develop a genuinely different reason to consider the kit in each variant rather than repeating its contents.

reviews.label: C08
reviews.strength: A product-aware shopper can find the price, components and key offer terms quickly.
reviews.priority_fix: Connect a component to a concrete use instead of relying on lists and purchase terms.

reviews.label: C09
reviews.strength: Separates contents, installation help and purchase terms into distinct angles.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace the first headline and make the purchase-terms variant say what the kit contains.

issues.quote: Six childproofing essentials in one kit
issues.reason: The supplied facts establish a six-part kit, not six separately identified essentials; the headline may imply a verified count of distinct items.

reviews.label: C10

reviews.priority_fix: Cut the repeated full offer-and-contents block and build three genuinely different angles.

issues.reason: The phrasing is unnatural; 'Save ₹299 on prepaid orders' says the same thing plainly.

reviews.label: C11
reviews.strength: Keeps practical reassurance separate from any promise of a child-safe home.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace broad phrases about household hazards with one concrete use for an included part.

reviews.label: C12
reviews.strength: Consistently answers installation hesitation with the available support claim.
reviews.priority_fix: Remove repeated contents and offer lists so each ad has a sharper setup-related point.

reviews.label: C13
reviews.strength: Offers three understandable routes to reassurance: components, guidance and purchase terms.
reviews.priority_fix: Show a particular household touchpoint in one variant rather than describing hazards generally.

reviews.label: C14
reviews.strength: Speaks directly to uncertainty about starting and installing the kit.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the second and third ads more distinct, and avoid turning 'six-part' into an item-count claim.

issues.reason: The facts support a six-part kit but do not verify that it contains exactly six individual items.

reviews.priority_fix: Tighten the repeated qualification and product name to give the component benefits more space.

reviews.label: C17

reviews.priority_fix: Make the prepaid variant’s practical product benefit clearer; weighing the payment option adds little.

reviews.label: C18
reviews.strength: The socket-guard variant gives installation uncertainty a specific object to focus on.
reviews.priority_fix: Name more of the included parts in the opening or price-led ad so shoppers can better understand the kit.
